statement: The function returns a result r and r = true if and only if L > n/2 or R > n/2 or P > n/2, where L is the number of nodes in the left child subtree of the node with value x (0 if that node has no left child), R is the number of nodes in its right child subtree (0 if it has no right child), and P = n - 1 - L - R. Equivalently, since n is odd, r = true if and only if 2*L > n or 2*R > n or 2*P > n.
preconditions: root is a binary tree with exactly n nodes; n is odd and 1 <= n <= 100; the node values are pairwise distinct and are exactly the integers 1,2,...,n; 1 <= x <= n, so the node whose value is x exists in root.

Then both calls btree_game_winning_move(root, n, x) and btree_game_winning_move(root', n, x) return results, and the returned Bools are equal.
